hints.title: Hole-Stopping Rolling Ball
hints.text: The ball rolls continuously in a chosen cardinal direction until it reaches a boundary wall or drops into the target hole.

hints.title: Lexicographical Direction Ordering
hints.text: Tie-break paths with identical step distances lexicographically using directional characters d, l, r, and u.

hints.title: Dijkstra Priority Exploration
hints.text: Queue states with tuple (dist, path, r, c). When expanding, roll until striking a wall or landing exactly on hole coordinates. Update minimum distance and string path at landing spots.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Dijkstra shortest path with roll raycasts and lexicographical string comparison.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple BFS misses shortest paths that require fewer total roll steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Min-heap orders candidate landings by (distance, path string) in O(M * N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use Dijkstra with hole boundary interruption and lexicographical tie-breaking.
